proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D E hD hE hprod
  have hAC : dist A C ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr hE.left_ne_right
  have hAB : dist A B ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr hD.left_ne_right
  have hAD : 0 < dist A D := dist_pos.mpr hD.left_ne
  have hang : EuclideanGeometry.angle D A E = EuclideanGeometry.angle C A B := by
    rw [hD.angle_eq_left E, EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm B A E, hE.angle_eq_left B]
  set r : ℝ := dist A D / dist A C with hr
  have hrpos : 0 < r := div_pos hAD (lt_of_le_of_ne dist_nonneg hAC.symm)
  have h1 : dist A D = r * dist A C := by rw [hr]; field_simp
  have h2 : dist A E = r * dist A B := by
    rw [hr]; field_simp; linarith
  have e := EuclideanGeometry.law_cos D A E
  have e' := EuclideanGeometry.law_cos C A B
  have h3 : dist D E = r * dist C B := by
    refine (mul_self_inj dist_nonneg (by positivity)).mp ?_
    have hDA : dist D A = r * dist C A := by rw [dist_comm D A, dist_comm C A]; exact h1
    have hEA : dist E A = r * dist B A := by rw [dist_comm E A, dist_comm B A]; exact h2
    rw [e, hang, hDA, hEA]
    linear_combination -(r * r) * e'
  refine similar_iff_exists_pos_dist_eq.mpr ⟨r, hrpos, fun i j => ?_⟩
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp <;> grind [dist_comm]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D E : P), Sbtw ℝ A D B → Sbtw ℝ A E C → dist A D * dist A B = dist A E * dist A C → Similar ![A, D, E] ![A, C, B]
